title: Vector Arena
core_loop: survive tactical wave sets -> defeat Guardian checkpoint -> choose mutation -> arena changes family/color and expands -> continue

score_rules.score_source: score_delta from kills, wave progress, and breach cores
score_rules.save_scope: local mission/game result packet; Prototype Lab validates and saves shared points when launched from the Lab
score_rules.prototype_lab_points: alias of profile_points_awarded for Lab-validated quest rewards

game_contract.save_ownership_rule: Standalone game owns its own session/profile output; no HoloVerse or Prototype Lab dependency.

origin_note: Originally prototyped as a HoloVerse dimension, then split into a standalone game. This pass preserves standalone use while restoring optional same-window native HoloVerse integration.
notes: Pass07.1 preserves all Pass07 gameplay and hardens the optional HoloVerse responder identity/host contract plus native pause/help ownership for same-window linking.

wave_director.spawn_rule: pooled and paced with per-enemy gate directives and visible gate charge telegraphs; total threats may exceed concurrent active cap
wave_director.rear_spawn_rule: not used in opening five-wave set; later rear pressure is explicitly telegraphed
wave_director.between_set_progression: after each Guardian checkpoint choose one of three equal-weight mutation paths with keys 1/2/3; combat pauses with no timer
wave_director.long_run_rule: population growth caps while durability/timing/mutations continue scaling; hazards cap at 38 raw damage
wave_director.enemy_evolution: staged by set and class, capped at level 4 with bounded health/speed/damage/cadence multipliers
wave_director.arena_area_growth: largest arena is about 3.73x the floor area of set 1
wave_director.large_arena_rule: spawn gates, family architecture, hazards, breach objectives, player/enemy bounds, and hitscan range follow the current arena profile
wave_director.blocker_authority: each visible opaque arena architecture piece and its gameplay blocker are created from the same architecture record; no independent hidden blocker layout
wave_director.navigation_validation: all gates, breach objectives and hazard points must remain reachable from center with player clearance; all visible architecture gaps remain physically open
